svg.title: Pentago: game 1, move 3
svg.desc: Game 1 of @tannergolden against GitHub, @tannergolden plays White and GitHub Black, under the Ghost Rule. Ghosts on b5 and c4. After 2... b2-ul-acw, the Arbiter's move for @tannergolden: a white marble on b2, then the upper left quarter turns anticlockwise. It is GitHub's turn as Black, due by 25 Nov. The upper left quarter: a ghost on b5, a ghost on c4; the lower left quarter: White on c3, Black on a2, White on b2; the lower right quarter: Black on d3.
